capabilities: Create and open interactive .samap battle maps inside Obsidian
Paint fog of war with circle, rectangle, square and polygon reveal tools
Place and move pins, images, videos and a grid layer on the map
Serve a read-only live player view over LAN via a built-in web server
Link map objects to notes and headings in the vault
extras: Desktop Obsidian only, since it runs a bundled local Node HTTP/WebSocket server; players connect from any browser on the same network. Listed in the directory as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run tabletop RPG battle maps or broadcast the game master's view to players during a session.
summary: Battle-map viewer for .samap files that adds fog of war, pins, grids and media, and live-shares the map to players' browsers over the local network.
